name: universal-research-memory
description: Codex-only provenance-first research memory, governed ingestion, and workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Codex research memory with governed workflows.
interface.longDescription: Universal Research provides source-grounded memory, recoverable governed ingestion, evidence-eligibility checks, and an eleven-role governance contract for Codex. Model selection, relevance review, agent sessions, and tool execution remain owned by the Codex host. The PyPI package does not ship external model APIs, generation-provider implementations, or plugin-owned agent runtimes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex host-owned execution only. Treat evidence eligibility as an integrity/range/count check, never proof of semantic support or truth. Treat canonical ingestion as a two-step, host-approved and recoverable operation bound to an immutable draft and exact receipt. Do not route work to external generation APIs, and keep visualization off unless explicitly approved.
